description: This file defines custom memory allocation and deallocation operators (operator new and operator delete) that use a custom allocator 'mlt_malloc' and 'mlt_free' when the macro USE_SYSRES_MLT is enabled. It overrides the global new/delete operators to incorporate custom tracking, including optional file and line information.

methods.name: operator new(unsigned int)
methods.description: Overrides global new operator to allocate memory using mlt_malloc.

methods.name: operator new[](unsigned int)
methods.description: Overrides global new[] operator to allocate memory using mlt_malloc.

methods.name: operator new(unsigned int, const char *, int)
methods.description: Overloaded new operator with file and line info for custom tracking.

methods.name: operator new[](unsigned int, const char *, int)
methods.description: Overloaded new[] operator with file and line info for custom tracking.

methods.name: operator delete(void *)
methods.description: Overrides global delete operator to free memory using mlt_free.
